activity.notes: Stefan Uroš IV Dušan ruled as king of Serbia from 1331 until his imperial coronation at Skopje on Easter, 16 April 1346. The mod's cross-civilization 'Serbia, Greece and Byzantium' framing is not treated as three separate sovereign offices.

sources.title: University of Bologna CRIS — Stefan Duszan
sources.citation_text: The University of Bologna research entry identifies Dušan as king of Serbia 1331–1346 and emperor of the Serbs, Greeks and Albanians 1346–1355, crowned at Skopje on 16 April 1346.

sources.title: Austrian Academy of Sciences — Stefan Uroš IV Dušan
sources.citation_text: The Austrian Academy research dataset records Stefan Dušan's death on 20 December 1355 and describes his reign as king 1331–1346 and emperor 1346–1355.
